subject: Film & Cinema
title: Pixar: The Story Comes First
description: A fast breakdown of Pixar: The Story Comes First for builders.

hook.text: Pixar's first rule: story is king. Technology serves the story, never the other way around.

buildup.text: Toy Story in 1995 was the first fully computer-animated feature film — a seismic shift.

discovery.text: Pixar's brain trust — a group of directors who critique each other's work — keeps quality high.

twist.text: Even Pixar stumbles — sequels and streaming-only releases have diluted their once-perfect brand.

climax.text: Pixar proved that computer animation can make audiences cry, not just marvel.

punchline.text: Pixels tell better stories when stories come first.

quiz.question: What was the first fully computer-animated feature film?
